description: CodeForge native seed benchmark — a small, representative, multi-category suite whose only purpose is to validate the evaluation infrastructure (runner, isolation, checks, metrics, trace, baseline, regression). Not a leaderboard. Each task is behavior-verified by deterministic checks, never by an expected patch.

tasks.title: Fix an off-by-one in a sum helper
tasks.description: The function sumToN in src/math.js is supposed to return 1+2+...+n but returns one short. Fix it so the tests pass.

tasks.title: Add an isEven helper
tasks.description: Add an exported function isEven(n) to src/util.js that returns true for even integers and false otherwise. Keep the existing exports.

seedFiles.src/util.js:
function isPositive(n) { return n > 0; }
module.exports = { isPositive };

tasks.title: Rename a function without breaking callers
tasks.description: Rename the function calc to computeTotal in src/order.js and update its caller in src/index.js. Behavior must be unchanged.

seedFiles.src/index.js:
const { calc } = require('./order.js');
module.exports = { total: (xs) => calc(xs) };

tasks.title: Write a test for an existing function
tasks.description: Create test.js that requires src/str.js and asserts that reverse('abc') === 'cba'. Running `node test.js` must exit 0.

seedFiles.src/str.js:
function reverse(s) { return s.split('').reverse().join(''); }
module.exports = { reverse };

tasks.title: Diagnose and fix a thrown error
tasks.description: Running `node run.js` currently throws because parseConfig returns undefined for an empty string. Make parseConfig return an empty object for empty/whitespace input so run.js prints the port.

tasks.title: Add a feature spanning two modules
tasks.description: Add a function discount(price, pct) to src/pricing.js and use it in src/checkout.js so checkoutTotal applies the discount. Keep existing behavior for pct=0.

seedFiles.src/pricing.js:
function tax(price) { return price * 0.1; }
module.exports = { tax };

tasks.title: Find and document the entry point
tasks.description: Create ENTRY.md stating which file is the application entry point (the one that starts the server) and the port it listens on.

tasks.title: Migrate require() to a single shared constant
tasks.description: Both src/a.js and src/b.js hardcode the base URL 'http://localhost:3000'. Extract it to src/config.js as BASE_URL and have both modules import it. Behavior unchanged.

verification.description: shared BASE_URL used by both modules

tasks.title: Generate a tiny CLI from scratch
tasks.description: Create a Node CLI at bin/greet.js so that `node bin/greet.js World` prints exactly 'Hello, World!'. The workspace starts empty.

tasks.title: Separate a monolith into layers
tasks.description: src/app.js mixes HTTP handling and business logic. Split the pure business logic (the add function) into src/domain.js and have src/app.js import it. The test must still pass.
